import csv, json, re, collections, os

base = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")
inv = {}
order = []
with open(os.path.join(base, "backoffice", "invoices.csv"), newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        inv[r["id"]] = float(r["amount"])
        order.append(r["id"])

pat = re.compile(r"(?:inv[-\s]?|invoice\s+)(\d{4})", re.I)
pay = collections.defaultdict(list)
ignored = []
with open(os.path.join(base, "backoffice", "bank_statement_june.csv"), newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        memo, amt = r["memo"], float(r["amount"])
        m = pat.search(memo)
        if not m or amt <= 0:
            ignored.append((memo, amt))
            continue
        pid = "INV-" + m.group(1)
        if pid not in inv:
            ignored.append((memo, amt))
            continue
        pay[pid].append(amt)

unpaid = [i for i in order if i not in pay]
duplicated = sorted(i for i, p in pay.items() if len(p) > 1)
mismatched = [
    {"id": i, "invoiced": round(inv[i], 2), "paid": round(pay[i][0], 2)}
    for i in order
    if len(pay.get(i, [])) == 1 and abs(pay[i][0] - inv[i]) > 0.005
]
out = {"unpaid": unpaid, "duplicated": duplicated, "mismatched": mismatched}
with open(os.path.join(base, "reconciliation.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("invoices", len(inv), "matched_ids", len(pay), "ignored", ignored)
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
